texts.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]已着手在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系建造一个史诗级项目。他们旨在建造一个巨大的环形世界以环绕恒星系的恒星，作为项目的第一步他们开始将星系所有行星转换为巨型结构的金属骨架。
texts.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has undertaken a construction project of monumental proportions in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system. They intend to build a massive Ring World around the system's primary, and as a first step they have started to convert the matter of all nearby planetary bodies into an initial metal skeleton for the megastructure.

texts.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]开始建造另一个环形世界，这次是在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系！和以前一样他们的工程师正在拆解星系的所有行星，用他们的资源和材料进行环形世界建造。
texts.en: We have received intelligence that the [From.GetName] is about to start construction on yet another Ring World, this time in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system! As before, their engineers are currently in the process of dismantling all planetary bodies in the system so that their resources and materials can be used in the Ring World's construction.

label.zh: 那个环会和我们的一样壮观吗？
label.en: Will it be as impressive as our own?

label.zh: 一项壮举，如果能完成的话。
label.en: An impressive project... if it is ever finished.
